title: The Episode About the Khalsa.. U

blocks.text: As offerings gather at the shrine, the Bandais grow alarmed and start pressing claims over authority, offerings, and ritual legitimacy.
The Khalsa hesitates to turn this into immediate violence, but the atmosphere of rivalry becomes too sharp to hide.
Bandais grow alarmed is the page’s center because growth in one camp means visible insecurity in the other.
